title: 第十一章 青梅竹马

content_zh:
交完任务，差不多也是午饭时间了，林铮干脆下线找吃的再说。家里储藏了一大堆的泡面，这将就一顿还是很容易解决的。于是林铮烧了两人份的水，顺便把杨琪的那一份也泡好了，把她从游戏里敲出来吃。吃完面，有感于自己对游戏的了解实在是太少，几乎和小白差不多，林铮很无奈地幻灵是一款很特别的游戏，其创作的理念其实并不是简单地作为一个游戏，而是构建另一个人类可以生存的精神世界，所以这个游戏世界并没有什么主线，也就没有什么主线任务之类的。但这个世界的构建采纳了无数人的构思、幻想与期望，加上中央电脑强大的衍生系统，已经形成了一个剧情极为精彩多变的世界！换句话说，你就是某天见到了某个牛逼的小说人物或者是动漫人物，那也不稀奇！幻灵，本来就是一个充满了幻想与仙灵的精彩世界！
官网上还介绍，随着游戏的进展，以后可能会取消所谓的职业差别，连人物属性与等级什么的都会取消，成为一个更为接近真实的世界！当然，这将是很久以后的事情了！就目前来说，在没有很多人满级之前，这种情况不会发生。
对于游戏的世界观，林铮只是简单地了解了一下，为了攻略游戏，他主要的精力还是放在一些游戏攻略与技巧上面。对于一些基本信息，也是斟酌了许久，算是对游戏有了比较深入的了解了。比之杨琪，大概也就缺少了玩一代《幻灵》的经验了，毕竟《幻灵贰》的很多默认设定都与一代一样，没有亲身体验可不知道。
看完游戏资料，时间已是1点50分，林铮不慌不忙地登入游戏，半梦半醒之后，便出现在了职业大厅的门口。刚一上线，信息提示便响个不停，了，然后过他惊讶地发现，小喵居然不在队伍里面。
“咦！？小喵呢？还没上吗？”林铮在队伍频道问道。
“呃！这个嘛！每天中午十二点半到两点，小喵需要午睡，顺便说一下，晚上九点半小喵准时睡觉！”蒂法的声音传进了林铮耳中，林铮立刻一副“哦！原来如此！”的表情，“果然小喵还是个孩子啊！”林铮道，“真是个好孩子！”
“你最好不要让她听到这些话！”蒂法偷笑着说到，“她会找你拼命的！”
“话说起来小喵真的很可爱啊！她真的已经18岁了吗？这是不是就是传说中的萝莉啊！估计小喵很受某些怪大叔的欢迎吧！”
“哈哈！霸王就是最大的怪大叔！你不知道！在一代的时候霸王就是……啊——！”龙牙的声音传进了林铮的耳朵，最后那一声惨叫可把林铮吓得不轻，随即霸王的声音传来，“死一边去！这里谁不知道你最猥琐！”
“哈哈哈！”林铮大笑着，不知不觉，已经走出天霜城了。正想要前去与霸王他们会合，一道娇小的身影从他眼前一掠而过，一身黑色的斗篷，尖尖的巫师帽下面露出了一张林铮有些熟悉的小脸。
“那个！我稍等一下过去！”林铮在队伍频道里说到。
“嗯？有什么事？”
“有个人，有点在意！”说着，林铮已经转身追向那道身影，“嘿嘿！肯定是妹子！”龙牙淫荡的声音传来，听得林铮直翻白眼。
“有希！？”林铮冲那女孩喊了一声，其实他也不太确定，这个女孩是不是他认识的那个人，毕竟已经有将近8年没有见过她了，不过，当女孩听到他的喊叫之后停了下来，林铮已经基本确定，就是自己认识的那个孩子！
停下，转身，多么干净利索的的动作，一张恬静的脸蛋映入林铮眼中，沉默寡言的表情，短短的黑色头发，参差不齐的刘海，无机质的大眼睛散发着透明的光芒，熟悉中带着几分陌生，当然了，曾经12岁的小女孩，现在已经20了呢！不过林铮已经完全肯定，这就是他认识的那个女孩——长孙有希！
话说有希这个女孩，曾经让林铮十分的无语！有希的双亲都是极品的动漫fan，在这对极品父母的熏陶下，有希毫无意外地成了个超级御宅族！十岁的有希能当着林铮的面，面不改色地玩18禁的恋爱游戏，这是多么的彪悍！把当时的林铮雷的外焦里嫩！

content_en:
After handing in the task, it was almost lunch time, so Lin Zheng simply went offline to find something to eat. I have a lot of instant noodles stored at home, so it’s easy to make up for just one meal. So Lin Zheng boiled water for two people, soaked Yang Qi's portion and knocked her out of the game to eat. After eating the noodles, he felt that his understanding of the game was too little, almost like a novice. Lin Zheng was helpless and said that Phantom is a very special game. The concept of its creation is not simply to be a game, but to build another spiritual world where humans can survive. Therefore, this game world does not have a main line, and there is no main line mission. But the construction of this world has adopted the ideas, fantasies and expectations of countless people, coupled with the powerful derivative system of the central computer, it has formed a world with extremely exciting and changeable plots! In other words, it’s not unusual for you to meet an awesome novel or anime character one day! Phantom is originally a wonderful world full of fantasy and fairies!
The official website also states that as the game progresses, the so-called professional differences may be canceled in the future, and even character attributes and levels will be cancelled, creating a world closer to reality! Of course, this will be a long time coming! For now, that won't happen until there aren't a lot of people maxed out.
Lin Zheng only had a brief understanding of the world view of the game. In order to master the game, his main focus was on some game strategies and techniques. I have also considered some basic information for a long time, and now I have a relatively in-depth understanding of the game. Compared with Yang Qi, he probably lacks the experience of playing the first generation of "Phantom". After all, many of the default settings of "Phantom 2" are the same as those of the first generation. You don't know without personal experience.
After reading the game information, it was already 1:50. Lin Zheng logged into the game calmly. After half-asleep, he appeared at the door of the career hall. As soon as he went online, the information prompts kept ringing, and then he was surprised to find that Xiaomiao was not in the team.
"Eh!? Where's Xiao Meow? Haven't you come yet?" Lin Zheng asked in the team channel.
"Uh! That's it! Every day from 12:30 to 2 o'clock, Xiao Meow needs to take a nap. By the way, Xiao Meow goes to bed on time at 9:30 in the evening!" Tifa's voice reached Lin Zheng's ears, and Lin Zheng immediately had an "Oh! That's it!" expression, "Sure enough, Xiao Meow is still a child!" Lin Zheng said, "What a good boy!"
"You'd better not let her hear these words!" Tifa snickered, "She will fight for you!"
"Speaking of which, Xiao Meow is really cute! Is she really 18 years old? Is she the legendary Lolita? I guess Xiao Meow is very popular with some weird uncles!"
"Haha! The Overlord is the biggest weird uncle! You don't know! In the first generation, the Overlord was...ah!" Longya's voice passed into Lin Zheng's ears, and the last scream scared Lin Zheng. Then the Overlord's voice came, "Go away! Who here doesn't know that you are the most wretched!"
"Hahaha!" Lin Zheng laughed, and before he knew it, he had already walked out of Tianshuang City. Just as he was about to join Overlord and the others, a petite figure flashed past his eyes, wearing a black cloak and a pointed wizard hat, revealing a small face that was somewhat familiar to Lin Zheng.
"That! I'll go there in a moment!" Lin Zheng said in the team channel.
"Huh? What's the matter?"
"There's someone I care about!" As he said that, Lin Zheng turned around and chased that figure, "Hey! It must be a girl!" Long Ya's lewd voice came, making Lin Zheng roll his eyes.
"Youxi!?" Lin Zheng shouted to the girl. In fact, he was not sure whether this girl was the person he knew. After all, there was already a general.He hadn't seen her in nearly 8 years, but when the girl stopped after hearing his shout, Lin Zheng was basically sure that she was the child he knew!
Stopping and turning around, such a neat movement, a quiet face came into Lin Zheng's eyes, with a taciturn expression, short black hair, uneven bangs, and big inorganic eyes that exuded a transparent light. It was familiar but a little strange. Of course, the little girl who was once 12 years old is now 20! But Lin Zheng was completely certain that this was the girl he knew - Changsun Youxi!
Speaking of this girl Youxi, Lin Zheng was once very speechless! Yuki's parents are both top anime fans. Under the influence of these two top parents, Yuki unsurprisingly became a super otaku! Ten-year-old Youxi can play the 18-year-old love game in front of Lin Zheng without changing her expression. How brave is this! Lin Zhenglei at that time was burnt on the outside and tender on the inside!
